newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar on Thursday as the dollar/mark firmed on European markets, dealers said.
The forint closed at 175.60/65 to the U.S. unit, compared to 175.35/45 at the opening and 175.57/62 at noon.
"It was featureless trading as the gap from the central bank bid remained at 50 pips and the forint just followed the dollar/mark," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
Luczo said he expected little change on Friday to the generally lacklustre picture. -- Budapest newsroom +36 1 327-4040
